name: Grade Goblin
flavorText: You don't climb things, you collect them. The number matters — a lot — and you will absolutely mention your hardest send within the first five minutes of meeting someone at the gym.
naturalHabitat: The hardest problem in the gym
villainLine: They'll happily flail on a V0 for fun. You physically cannot understand the appeal.
partnerLine: You keep it motivated, they keep it fun — you balance each other out more than either of you admits.
